Messages.Author: Algustas
Messages.Body:
Hi Methuselahs,
Recently Tom posted to this group concerning the timing of Pulled
Fangs, and stated that they can not be played until after additional
strikes have been resolved.
Has this issue ever been discussed for Taste of Vitae? The first
line clearly states that it is usable only after strike resolution, the
next line states that the vampire recieves an amount of blood equal to
the (errata - Damage) lost by the other vampire. It concludes with "Not
usable by a vampire going to torpor."
Does this enable you to play a taste of vitae after the first
strike resolution, thus giving you more blood to survive the additional
strikes of some Brujah blender? Or do you have to wait until after all
strike resolutions (aka Pulled Fangs)?
Before the Pulled Fangs rulling (clarification?) I would have
said it clearly could be used before additional strikes, but now I am not
so certain.
Scott, has this been ruled on / clarified?
Tom, does it need to be?
Algustas

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Algustas <cfr...@gladstone.uoregon.edu> writes:
>Hi Methuselahs,
> Recently Tom posted to this group concerning the timing of Pulled
>Fangs, and stated that they can not be played until after additional
>strikes have been resolved.
> Has this issue ever been discussed for Taste of Vitae? The first

> Does this enable you to play a taste of vitae after the first
>strike resolution, thus giving you more blood to survive the additional
>strikes of some Brujah blender? Or do you have to wait until after all
>strike resolutions (aka Pulled Fangs)?
> Before the Pulled Fangs rulling (clarification?) I would have
>said it clearly could be used before additional strikes, but now I am not
>so certain.
> Scott, has this been ruled on / clarified?

Yes. It can be used after *any* strike resolution set (but not between
first strike and normal strike resolution). If used before additional
strikes, it will not continue to 'gain' blood lost in those additional
strikes.
